class.name: SteamLeaderboardEntry
class.brief_description: One entry of a Steam leaderboard.

method.name: get_details
method.description: Returns the extra integers uploaded with the score. See [method Steam.upload_leaderboard_score].

method.name: get_global_rank
method.description: Returns the entry's global rank, starting at [code]1[/code].

method.name: get_persona_name
method.description: Returns the user's Steam display name, as known to the Steam client when the entries were downloaded. May be empty or [code][unknown][/code] for users the client has no information about yet.

method.name: get_steam_id
method.description: Returns the Steam ID of the user who owns this entry.

method.name: get_ugc_handle
method.description: Returns the handle of user-generated content attached to the entry, or [code]0[/code] if there is none.

method.name: is_local_user
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this entry belongs to the local user.
